stitches.description: Absorbs incoming damage by consuming charges. When charges reach 0, deals damage equal to the initial heal back to the player.

heart_strain.description: Reduces speed by 3 at the start of each turn. Lasts for 5 charges.

drip.description: Heals 1 health at the start and end of each turn. Lasts for 25 activations. Additional drips increase the duration.
